column7: rules.DecodePATScopes trimmed the stored personal_access_tokens.scopes column, so a whitespace-only value (never written by EncodePATScopes, which stores an exact empty column for no allowlist) decoded as unscoped and the PAT authenticated with its owner's full rights. Only the exact empty column (and a pre-ADR-042 NULL read back as empty) is unscoped now; whitespace-only decodes to the PATScopeCorrupted sentinel like null/[] and unparseable JSON, on ValidatePATToken and the per-request CurrentPATRestriction re-read. Same rule as the CIDR codec fix in #3840. Unit: internal/core/rules TestDecodePATScopes_UnscopedByDesignVsWhitespaceCorrupted.
